nodes.en: Finished session logs, read per agent
nodes.zh: 按 agent 格式读取的已结束会话日志

nodes.en: Command intent and failure patterns become candidate facts
nodes.zh: 命令意图与失败模式变成候选事实

nodes.en: 3 confirmations to activate; contradiction retires; 40% firing gate
nodes.zh: 3 次确认才生效；被反驳即退役；40% 触发门

nodes.en: At most 4 facts, about 150 tokens, at session start
nodes.zh: 会话开头最多 4 条、约 150 token

nodes.en: Unused-tool streaks over prompts and sessions
nodes.zh: 按提示数与会话数累计的未用工具

nodes.en: Deny list written into the agent's own settings after an idle window
nodes.zh: 空闲窗口后写进 agent 自己的配置

nodes.en: Per tool call: loop signals and a free gate
nodes.zh: 每次工具调用：循环信号与免费闸门

nodes.en: Envelope: percentile of turns that ended green
nodes.zh: 包络：正常结束轮次长度的分位数

nodes.en: Judge on your own agent CLI, tools off
nodes.zh: 在你自己的 agent CLI 上关工具跑判官

nodes.en: One redirect, then a notice; never stops the turn
nodes.zh: 提醒一次，再通知人；从不自行停止

nodes.en: Cache-aware cost ledger that includes the plugin's own calls
nodes.zh: 按缓存计价、含插件自身调用的成本账本

edges.zh: 开启 microskills 时可选的提案模型
